correctness.rationale: Exact determinant expansion gives characteristic polynomial λ³+3aλ²+Bλ+C, with B=1+3a²−3t²/4, C=ρ−ρ_−, and Hurwitz determinant H=ρ_+−ρ. Routh–Hurwitz proves the full iff classification. Monotonic C decreasing/H increasing for 0<a<1/sqrt(3) proves unique candidate boundary roots. Implicit function theorem yields order-a widths for ρ<8/(3sqrt(3)), order-a³ width 9a³/2 at equality, and reversed root order above. Boundary factorization gives pair imaginary and zero crossings; direct calculation gives the crossing derivatives. The verifier ran and passed exact rational determinant checks; its finite numerical checks are explicitly not the proof of infinitely many parameters.

value.rationale: A minimal genuinely overlapping negative-feedback network offers exact design conditions under a conservation constraint on average node decay. The sharp feedback-loop ratio separates whether weak damping permits heterogeneity-induced stability, and the nilpotent triple-zero produces a mathematically distinct cubic, versus generic linear, stability-window collapse. This motivates specific study of non-Hermitian feedback designs and is stronger than a sample stability calculation, while deliberately claiming only local linear spectral consequences.
